# Two dark rocks out in the sea, silhouettes against the sunset. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.3569 0.3255 0.4902 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name R1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.9 --location -4.2 0 0.2
scale 1.4 1 0.8
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name R2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.55 --location -2.9 0.4 0.05
select R1 R2
material assign Rock
select all
shade flat
export rocks.glb
